selection_rationale: Reverb/effects: the reference hardware reverbs a student meets in studios and live racks (Bricasti M7, Lexicon PCM96/PCM92, Yamaha SPX2000, Eventide H9000) plus one historic studio standard (Lexicon 480L) that teaches legacy digital I/O (PCM-1610 on DE9) and remote control. Feedback suppressor / automixer: dbx AFS2 (classic live anti-larsen in a 1U rack) and Shure SCM820 (IntelliMix automixer with Dante and DFR, common in conference/broadcast speech installs). Several requested candidates (TC Electronic M350/M3000, Yamaha REV7, EMT 140, Dugan, Sabine FBX, Eventide H3000) were dropped because their official sources could not be reached this session (see not_found_log).

devices.notes: Only one spec source (the scanned official manual, read as page images). The digital port is a PCM-1610-compatible interface on DE9, NOT AES3; aes3 was used on that connector only as the closest digital-audio signal id and is deliberately left out of signal_types. DE9 has no TekPractice id, so dsub25 is used as closest and 'de9' is proposed. Rack height is given as 5.25" (no rack-unit count stated in the pages read). Main inputs can optionally be transformer-coupled (Jensen JE-11P-1) per the manual.
